The Wedding Journey

Four celebrations of joy — 29 December to 2 January✦ Reveal ✦

01 · Mehndi & Nikkah

Tuesday, 29 December 2026✦ Reveal Date ✦

The celebrations open with a day of colour and blessings: henna, marigolds and joy — and on this same day, the sacred Nikkah of Shahzaib & Maham. The most blessed day of the celebrations.

02 · Dholki

Wednesday, 30 December 2026✦ Reveal Date ✦

The beat of the dhol carries the celebrations on — songs, laughter and family gathered together on the eve of the Barat.

03 · Barat — The Wedding

Thursday, 31 December 2026 · 09:00 PM✦ Reveal Date ✦

The main wedding function at Ameer Hamza Hall, New Karachi. Dinner will be served at 11:00 PM — a New Year’s Eve the family will never forget.

04 · Valima — Reception

Saturday, 2 January 2027✦ Reveal Date ✦

The groom’s family hosts the Valima reception — a graceful finale to the celebrations and the couple’s first gathering as husband and wife.
